findings.message: Audible clips overlap on Studio track 5: assets/sfx/impact/impactSoft_medium_001.ogg at 3.73-24s and assets/sfx/ui/click2.ogg at 7.09-24s. Both play at once whatever their track (the render mixes every audible clip; data-track-index only picks the Studio lane), and Studio draws them over each other in that lane.
findings.fixHint: If both should sound (a whoosh into a hit), give one its own data-track-index; the mix does not change. If one is a leftover duplicate, remove it or move it so the windows do not overlap.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.

The film's last line "Free, no account, about 6 minutes." (6 words) is on screen 1.96 s (±0.01 s), under the 2.00 s a closing line needs: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word and at least 2 s before the film ends; see references/motion.md.
